Gewährleistung einer klaren und wirksamen Kommunikation mit der Geschäftsleitung und anderen Führungskräften des Kasinos. skills.title_vi: Áp dụng chăm sóc điều dưỡng trong chăm sóc dài hạn
skills.title_en: apply nursing care in long-term care
skills.description: Enable the promotion and the development of nursing care in long term care, co-morbidity and in situations of dependency in order to maintain individuals’ personal autonomy and relationships with the environment in each moment of the health/illness process.

skills.title_vi: Đóng góp vào sự liên tục của chăm sóc sức khỏe
skills.title_en: contribute to continuity of health care
skills.description: Contribute to the delivery of coordinated and continuous healthcare.

skills.title_vi: Tổ chức chăm sóc tại nhà cho bệnh nhân
skills.description: Organise care to be provided in the house of a patient who is housebound with acute and/or long-term health problems.

skills.title_vi: Khởi xướng các biện pháp bảo tồn sự sống
skills.description: Initiate life-preserving actions by taking measures in crises and disaster situations.

skills.title_vi: Phân tích chất lượng chăm sóc
skills.description: Analyse the quality of care in order to improve the own professional practice as a general care nurse.

skills.title_vi: Tiến hành nghiên cứu về chăm sóc điều dưỡng tiên tiến
skills.title_en: conduct research in advanced nursing care
skills.description: Identify research priorities in advanced nursing care, lead, conduct and disseminate research findings that shape and advance nursing practice, education and policy.

skills.title_vi: Quyết định lâm sàng tại thực hành nâng cao
skills.description: Apply advanced practice with regard to clinical decision-making, managing the caseload for individual patients, families and communities.

skills.title_vi: Tuyên truyền hình ảnh tích cực về ngành điều dưỡng
skills.title_en: promote a positive image of nursing
skills.description: Present and preserve a positive image of nursing in specific environments of the healthcare and educational spectra.

skills.title_vi: Quản lý Thông tin trong Chăm sóc Sức khỏe
skills.description: Retrieve, apply and share information among patients and healthcare professionals and across healthcare facilities and community.

skills.title_vi: Cung cấp thông tin cho người quyết định chính sách về các thách thức liên quan đến sức khỏe
skills.title_en: inform policy makers on health-related challenges
skills.description: Provide useful information related to health care professions to ensure policy decisions are made in the benefit of communities.

skills.title_vi: Tư vấn về lối sống lành mạnh
skills.description: Promote healthy lifestyles, preventive measures and self-care by strengthening empowerment, promoting health and enhancing behaviours and therapeutic compliance, providing patients with the adequate information in order to support compliance with and adherence to prescribed treatments, medication and nursing care.

skills.title_vi: Thúc đẩy quyền con người
skills.description: Promote and respect human rights and diversity in light of the physical, psychological, spiritual and social needs of autonomous individuals, taking into account their opinions, beliefs and values, and the international and national codes of ethics, as well as the ethical implications of healthcare provision, ensuring their right to privacy and honouring for the confidentiality of healthcare information.

skills.title_vi: Đóng góp vào quyết định chiến lược sức khỏe cấp cao
skills.title_en: contribute to high level health strategic decisions
skills.description: Contribute to decision-making at clinical, management and policy level, such as the allocation of health funds.

skills.title_vi: Ra quyết định lâm sàng
skills.description: Respond to an information need by collecting and analysing available findings to inform clinical decisions.

skills.title_vi: điều hành các hoạt động nghiên cứu trong lĩnh vực điều dưỡng
skills.description: Lead nursing research initiatives, support research activity, working within individual Care Groups and with other agencies, identifying, applying and disseminating research findings related to specialist nursing.

skills.title_vi: Cung cấp tư vấn điều dưỡng về chăm sóc sức khỏe
skills.description: Give advice to, instruct and support persons needing nursing care and their attachment figures.

skills.title_vi: Cung cấp chiến lược điều trị cho các thách thức đối với sức khỏe con người
skills.title_en: provide treatment strategies for challenges to human health
skills.description: Identify possible treatment protocols for the challenges to human health within a given community in cases such as infectious diseases of high consequences at the global level.

skills.title_vi: Đánh giá Sức khỏe
skills.description: Autonomously perform comprehensive health assessment, using professional judgement to refer patients requiring specialist attention to other health professionals and agencies as appropriate.

skills.title_vi: Định hướng chăm sóc điều dưỡng nâng cao
skills.description: Prescribe evidence-based therapeutic interventions and medication, actively monitoring the effectiveness of patients treatments.

skills.title_vi: Điều chỉnh can thiệp vật lý trị liệu
skills.description: Adjust physiotherapy interventions based on re-evaluation of the client`s response to treatment.

skills.title_vi: Áp dụng nguyên tắc cơ bản của điều dưỡng
skills.description: Implement the nursing theoretical and methodological fundamentals and principles, basic nursing interventions on scientific evidence and the resources available.

skills.title_vi: Đề xuất Sức khỏe
skills.description: Advocate for health promotion, well-being and disease or injury prevention on behalf of clients and the profession to enhance community, public and population health.

skills.title_vi: Sàng lọc khách hàng
skills.description: Contribute to the triage process to assign clients to the most appropriate management pathway for their condition, in collaboration with other healthcare practitioners.

skills.title_vi: Triển khai ra quyết định khoa học trong chăm sóc sức khỏe
skills.title_en: implement scientific decision making in healthcare
skills.description: Implement scientific findings for evidence-based practice, integrating research evidence into decision making by forming a focused clinical question in response to a recognised information need, searching for the most appropriate evidence to meet that need, critically appraising the retrieved evidence, incorporating the evidence into a strategy for action, and evaluating the effects of any decisions and actions taken.

skills.title_vi: Thực hiện xuất viện do điều dưỡng dẫn dắt
skills.description: Initiate and lead the discharge process of patients, involving all relevant professionals to expedite discharges. Assist bed and capacity management across the whole hospital.

skills.title_vi: Thực hiện chăm sóc điều dưỡng
skills.description: Implement nursing care when treating patients in order to improve their health situation. Carry out advanced treatment, diagnostic and invasive interventions as related to the field of specialisation.

skills.title_vi: Phát triển kế hoạch liên quan đến chuyển giao chăm sóc
skills.title_en: develop plans related to the transfer of care
skills.description: Organise transfer of care, when applicable, across a range of healthcare settings, communicating effectively and ensuring that the patient/client and carers are involved in the decision making process.

skills.title_vi: Chẩn đoán chăm sóc điều dưỡng nâng cao
skills.description: Examine and diagnose advanced nursing care using evidence based therapeutic interventions.

skills.title_vi: Thích nghi phong cách lãnh đạo trong chăm sóc sức khỏe
skills.description: Adapt leadership styles and approaches to different situations concerning nursing clinical practice and healthcare.

skills.title_vi: Cung cấp chăm sóc chuyên nghiệp trong điều dưỡng
skills.description: Provide professional care, adequate to the health and nursing care needs of the individuals, families and groups, taking into account the scientific developments, as well as the quality and safety requirements established in accordance with the legal/professional conduct regulations.

skills.title_vi: Đổi mới Dịch vụ Chăm sóc Sức khỏe
skills.description: Identify and lead changes in healthcare service in response to patient needs and service demand in order to ensure continuous quality improvement of the service.

skills.title_vi: Giáo dục về phòng ngừa bệnh tật
skills.title_en: educate on the prevention of illness
skills.description: Offer evidence-based advice on how to avoid ill health, educate and advise individuals and their carers on how to prevent ill health and/or be able to advise how to improve their environment and health conditions. Provide advice on the identification of risks leading to ill health and help to increase the patients' resilience by targeting prevention and early intervention strategies.

skills.title_vi: Thu thập dữ liệu chung của người dùng chăm sóc sức khỏe
skills.description: Collect qualitative and quantitative data related to the healthcare user's anagraphic data and provide support on filling out the present and past history questionnaire and record the measures/tests performed by the practitioner.

skills.title_vi: Sử dụng ngoại ngữ cho nghiên cứu liên quan đến sức khỏe
skills.title_en: use foreign languages for health-related research
skills.description: Use foreign languages for conducting and collaborating in health-related research.

skills.title_vi: Phân tích vấn đề một cách批判
skills.description: Identify the strengths and weaknesses of various abstract, rational concepts, such as issues, opinions, and approaches related to a specific problematic situation in order to formulate solutions and alternative methods of tackling the situation.

skills.title_vi: Phản hồi với các tình huống thay đổi trong chăm sóc sức khỏe
skills.title_en: respond to changing situations in health care
skills.description: Cope with pressure and respond appropriately and in time to unexpected and rapidly changing situations in healthcare.

skills.title_vi: Trao quyền cho cá nhân, gia đình và nhóm
skills.description: Empower individuals, families and groups towards healthy lifestyles and self-care.

skills.title_vi: có kiến thức cơ bản về máy tính
skills.description: Utilise computers, IT equipment and modern day technology in an efficient way.

skills.title_vi: Đóng góp vào quá trình phục hồi
skills.description: Contribute to the rehabilitation process to enhance activity, functioning and participation using a person-centered and evidence-based approach.

skills.title_vi: Khuyến nghị sản phẩm chăm sóc sức khỏe
skills.description: Prescribe healthcare products, when indicated, for therapeutic effectiveness, appropriate to the client`s needs and in accordance with evidence-based practice, national and practice protocols and within scope of practice.

skills.title_vi: Giám sát trợ lý vật lý trị liệu
skills.description: Supervise and provide learning opportunities for physiotherapist assistants.

skills.title_vi: Cung cấp thực hành lâm sàng nâng cao trong vật lý trị liệu
skills.title_en: provide advanced clinical practice in physiotherapy
skills.description: Provide advanced clinical advice to individual clients or groups in relation to physiotherapy diagnosis and planning of complex interventions, supporting other physiotherapists in planning client care and in understanding the role and responsibilities of the advanced physiotherapist.

skills.title_vi: Quản lý nhân viên y tế
skills.description: The managerial tasks and responsibilities required in a health care setting.

skills.title_vi: Phát triển kế hoạch chiến lược cho dịch vụ vật lý trị liệu
skills.title_en: develop strategic plans for physiotherapy services
skills.description: Contribute to the development of systems, policies and procedures for the provision of physiotherapy services, sharing knowledge and contributing to internal and external learning opportunities.

skills.title_vi: Tham gia nghiên cứu vật lý trị liệu
skills.description: Undertake different levels of engagement in research activities to improve the quality of, and evidence base for, physiotherapy.

This may include providing B & B services, small scale catering, supporting agri-tourism activities and leisure such as riding, locally guide tours, giving information on farm production and history, selling of small-scale local farm products.

skills.title_vi: phòng trừ sâu bệnh ở thực vật
skills.description: Types and features of pests in plants and crops. Different kinds of pest control methods, activities using conventional or biological methods taking into account the type of plant or crop, environmental and climate conditions and health and safety regulations. Storage and handling of products.

skills.title_vi: cửa hàng cây trồng

skills.title_vi: sinh thái

skills.title_vi: thực hiện các xét nghiệm trong phòng thí nghiệm

skills.title_vi: du lịch nông nghiệp
skills.description: Aspects of agritourism involving agriculturally based activities to bring visitors to a farm.

skills.title_vi: quản lý hoạt động du lịch nông nghiệp

Train staff to carry out the different services according to the plan.
